newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar rated attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar rated attractive.

text.p: Bear, Stearns & Co Inc said on Monday it started coverage of Brazilian supermarket chain Companhia Brasileira de Distribucao SA with an attractive rating.
-- The company is generally known as Pao de Acucar.
-- Analyst David Wheeler said in a research note the company was firmly entrenched in Brazilian neighborhoods and would be expanding the number of its hypermarkets over the next two years.
-- In U.S. dollars, Wheeler said his 1997 earnings estimate was $1.65 per share and his 1998 estimate was $2.17 per share.
-- "We expect CBD...to continue its effective strategy of both expanding sales area and remodeling stores which should lead to both nominal and same-store sales growth," he said.
-- Its preferred stock closed up 1.74 percent at 26.25 reais on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
-- Its ADR rose 1/2 to 24-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
-- Its common stock last traded on April 30 at 17.11 reais.
